S043.name: Restrictive_Intake
S043.description: Persistent restriction of energy intake relative to requirements, leading to significantly low body weight.

subtypes.Eating Very Small Amounts: Eating only one or two bites a day or extremely small portions per meal.
subtypes.Skipping Meals: Intentionally skipping breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
subtypes.Exclusion of Specific Food Groups: Strictly avoiding specific food groups like carbohydrates or fats to prevent nutritional imbalance.
subtypes.Strict Calorie Restriction: Limiting daily caloric intake to an extremely low level.

S044.name: Low_Weight
S044.description: A body weight that is significantly below the minimum level of health for age, sex, developmental trajectory, and physical health.

subtypes.Continuous Weight Loss: A state where weight continues to decrease due to intentional restriction of intake.
subtypes.Insistence on Low Weight: Attempting to lose more weight or refusing to restore weight despite already being underweight.

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.

subtypes.Fear of Weight Gain: Extreme fear and loathing of gaining weight or becoming fat.
subtypes.Fear of Specific Foods: Fear that eating high-calorie foods will immediately lead to weight gain.
subtypes.Obsession with Weight Gain: Compulsively checking the scale and becoming extremely anxious about even the slightest increase.

S084.name: Low_Weight_Severity_Non_Recognition
S084.description: Persistent lack of recognition of the seriousness of the current low body weight.

subtypes.Denial of Medical Risk: Not admitting or dismissing the health risks caused by being underweight.
subtypes.Disregard of Symptoms: Not taking physical symptoms caused by low weight (dizziness, hair loss, amenorrhea) seriously.
subtypes.Dismissal of Concerns: Exaggerating or rejecting the concerns of doctors or family as unnecessary.

patient_info.stressor_event: Gaining a new family member (e.g., birth, adoption, older adult moving in)
patient_info.stressor: Steven’s household changed when an older relative moved in, filling the kitchen and family schedule with caregiving routines on top of his late repair-shop hours, Mustang projects, and weekend community commitments. He responded by tightening his own eating into a strict, self-imposed system he described as staying light for basketball and keeping discipline during stressful weeks, and the pattern gradually led to a body weight below what was healthy for him. Although the weight loss was clinically significant, he minimized it as a practical adjustment and remained strongly opposed to gaining weight, insisting that putting weight back on would make him sluggish. He entered care through his primary-care doctor after a routine physical for work documented the low weight and Steven agreed to a psychiatric referral mainly to protect his ability to keep working and playing in his league.

S043.name: Restrictive_Intake
S043.description: Persistent restriction of energy intake relative to requirements, leading to significantly low body weight.
S043.manifestation: Most days I keep it to coffee in the morning, maybe a small sandwich or half of whatever is around later, because with the shop running late and the house busy I feel better sticking to my own simple rules.

S044.name: Low_Weight
S044.description: A body weight that is significantly below the minimum level of health for age, sex, developmental trajectory, and physical health.
S044.manifestation: My work physical is what got me here—the doctor said my weight is too low, but to me I just feel lighter on my feet for basketball and not as weighed down at the garage.

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.
S045.manifestation: If I see the scale bump up even a pound or my jeans feel tighter, I start thinking I’m getting soft and that I’ll be slower moving around cars or up and down the court.

S084.name: Low_Weight_Severity_Non_Recognition
S084.description: Persistent lack of recognition of the seriousness of the current low body weight.
S084.manifestation: I know people are worried, but I figure they’re making too much of it since I still show up for work, take care of what needs doing at home, and play ball on weekends.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I’m still keeping up with the garage and my basketball league, but it has caused tension at home because I avoid sitting down for regular family meals and people keep asking if I’m okay.
